policy: This inventory accounts for all 237 tests at sourceCommit. Assertion-level review is complete: pure UI originals are removed, mixed originals retain only technical contracts, and technical-only originals remain deterministic. Evidence is per case; a run containing a passed case may itself fail or be interrupted. Local evidence is not remote CI evidence.
replacementPolicy: All originals have an explicit replacementStatus. allOriginalAssertionsPreserved remains false because AI assertions replace visible-behavior matchers rather than preserve each original assertion literally; exact technical contracts remain deterministic. candidateCaseIds and replacementEvidenceRuns identify the verified visible counterpart, not a promise that every referenced run passed in full.
